<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**[[2020 Mozambique attacks]]
***[[Islamist]] militants are reported to have [[behead]]ed over 50 people in a [[massacre]] at a village in [[Cabo Delgado Province]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-54877202 (BBC News)]
*[[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War]]
**[[Battle of Shusha (2020)]]
***The [[Azerbaijani Armed Forces|Azerbaijani military]] says it has captured the city of [[Shusha]] in [[Nagorno-Karabakh]]. [[President of Azerbaijan|Azerbaijani President]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] says "We have won this victory on the battlefield, not at the negotiating table". [[Armenia]] and [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]] leaders deny the loss of the city but say "fierce fighting" is ongoing inside the city. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/11/08/world/europe/nagorno-karabakh-azerbaijan-shusha.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Tigray military intervention]]
**[[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Ethiopian Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]] abruptly sacks and replaces the [[Chief of General Staff (Ethiopia)|Chief of General Staff]] of the [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|Ethiopian military]] General Adem Mohammed, Foreign Minister [[Gedu Andargachew]] and the head of intelligence Demelash Gebremichael. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-54864868 (BBC News)]
**In a televised address, Ahmed accuses [[Tigray Region|Tigray]]'s [[Tigray People's Liberation Front|regional leaders]] of "preparing for war" against the [[Government of Ethiopia|federal government]] since 2018, saying the group had siphoned federal development funds to buy weapons and train [[militia]]s. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/08/ethiopia-reports-of-heavy-casualties-in-fighting-in-tigray (''The Guardian'')]

;Health and environment 
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 1,328 new infections, marking a new single-day record for a second day in a row. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/ontario-covid-19-numbers-report-nov-8-1.5794404 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] reports 1,397 new cases in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began and surpasssing previous record one month ago. [https://montreal.ctvnews.ca/mobile/quebec-reports-a-record-1-397-new-covid-19-cases-and-nine-deaths-1.5179932 (CFCF-DT)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
*****[[Minnesota]] reports 5,908 new cases, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.startribune.com/state-hits-fresh-record-with-5-908-new-coronavirus-cases/573008861/ (''Minneapolis Star Tribune'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Utah]]
*****[[Governor of Utah|Utah governor]] [[Gary Herbert]] declares a [[state of emergency]] and ordered a statewide mask mandate in an attempt to stem a surge of COVID-19. [https://kutv.com/news/coronavirus/gov-herbert-declares-new-state-of-emergency-to-address-hospital-overcrowding-case-surge (KUTV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Delhi]]
*****[[Delhi]] reports the highest single-day spike of 7,745 new cases of COVID-19, taking the capital’s total to 438,529 cases. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/record-spike-of-7-745-new-covid-19-cases-in-delhi-death-toll-rises-to-6-989/story-o4hrxpa3HaMVdPaRC7CeFK.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****The [[Minister of Education (Malaysia)|Education Ministry]] orders all schools across the country to close as part of the implementation of a [[2020 Malaysia movement control order|conditional movement control order]] in most states from tomorrow until the end of the academic year. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-schools-close-nov-9-covid-19-cmco-13492442 (CNA)]
****[[Malaysia]] surpasses 40,000 cumulative cases of COVID-19. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2020/11/08/covid-19-852-new-cases-bring-total-past-40k-mark-four-new-deaths (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports 459 new fatalities in the last 24 hours, its single-day record since the pandemic began, raising the nationwide death toll to 38,291. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20201108-irans-daily-covid-19-deaths-hit-record-of-459/ (Middle East Monitor)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Albania]]
****[[Albania]] reports 501 new cases in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record and becomes the first time the country reports more than 500 cases in a single day. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-11/09/c_139501358.htm (Xinhua)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports 35 new fatalities in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record, pushing the nationwide death toll to 734. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/258944/article/ekathimerini/news/record-35-deaths-from-coronavirus-announced (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Prime Minister of Portugal|Prime Minister]] [[Antonio Costa]] announces that [[Portugal]] will impose a localized nighttime curfew from 11:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m., in 121 [[Municipalities of Portugal|municipalities]] across the country, affecting 70% of the population, beginning tomorrow. People will also be prevented from leaving their homes between 1:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. on Saturdays and Sundays. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-portugal/portugal-imposes-local-night-time-curfews-as-covid-19-cases-hit-record-idUKKBN27O00X (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Premier of Victoria|Victorian Premier]] [[Daniel Andrews]] announces a lift on restrictions of the {{convert|25|km|mi|adj=on}} travel limit in [[Melbourne]] and the "ring of steel" separating the city from [[Victoria (Australia)|Regional Victoria]] from 11:59 p.m  [[Time in Australia|AEDT]] tonight. He also announces that gyms, theatres and cinemas will reopen tomorrow, and more people will be allowed in hospitality and religious venues. It is also the first time that all of Victoria has been on the same restriction level since late June. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-11-08/daniel-andrews-confirms-victorian-coronavirus-restrictions-lift/12861082 (ABC Australia)]
**The number of confirmed worldwide [[COVID-19]] cases surpasses 50 million. The [[United States]] remains the country with the most confirmed cases, accounting for 20% of all cases worldwide. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-54867793 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Myanmar general election]]
**Voters in [[Myanmar]] head to the polls. [[State Counsellor of Myanmar|State Counsellor]] [[Aung San Suu Kyi]]'s [[National League for Democracy]] is expected to win the election, despite international accusations of [[Persecution of Muslims in Myanmar|genocide and persecution]] of the [[Rohingya]] minority, who were also stripped of their voting rights in 2015. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-54820946 (BBC News)]
*[[Luis Arce]] is sworn in as [[President of Bolivia]], succeeding [[Jeanine Áñez]]. [https://www.elmundo.es/internacional/2020/11/08/5fa7fda8fdddff30748b45a7.html (''El Mundo'')]
*[[Government of Turkey|Turkish]] [[Ministry of Finance and Treasury (Turkey)|Finance Minister]] [[Berat Albayrak]] announces his [[resignation]] on [[social media]] due to "health reasons". It comes two days after the chief of the [[Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey|Turkish Central Bank]] was fired by [[President of Turkey|President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-economy-minister/turkish-finance-minister-resigns-in-second-surprise-departure-after-lira-slide-idUSKBN27O0UA (Reuters)]
*[[Imperial House of Japan|Japanese prince]] [[Fumihito, Prince Akishino|Fumihito]] is officially made heir to the [[Chrysanthemum Throne]]. The crowning ceremony had been delayed by seven months due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan|COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-54849455 (BBC News)]
*Fra' [[Marco Luzzago]] is elected the new [[List of Princes and Grand Masters of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta|Lieutenant of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta]]. The Order also postpones election for Grand Master. [https://www.romereports.com/en/2020/11/09/order-of-malta-elects-lieutenant-and-postpones-election-for-grand-master/ (Rome Reports)]
;Science and technology
*[[Virgin Hyperloop]] makes its initial run with human passengers, achieving a top speed of 107 mph (172 kph) using [[magnetic levitation]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2020/nov/09/first-passengers-travel-in-virgins-levitating-hyperloop-pod-system (''The Guardian'')]
